Frequently Asked Questions

What interior design services do you offer in Rajokri?

Space planning, concept design, 3D views, working drawings, material and furniture selection, lighting and site supervision for farmhouses, homes and commercial spaces.

Can you design guest houses and staff quarters?

Yes. Guest houses, staff quarters and service areas are planned along with the main house so the whole property works smoothly.

Do you work on event venues?

Yes. We design banquet halls, lawns and event spaces with flexible layouts, lighting and durable finishes.

Why choose end-to-end interior design services for a farmhouse?

A farmhouse has many buildings and outdoor areas. One team handling design and supervision keeps the style and quality consistent.
